slice: foundation-dx (spec 2026-08-02): forms + error copy + offset pagination, gallery demos

out_of_radius.api: packages/contracts pagination change has ZERO server consumers — no list endpoint exists (Law 9); apps/api diff is CLAUDE.md only. Recorded here so the omission cannot read as a silent skip.
out_of_radius.always_on_core: auth is torn down (ADR-0024, walkthrough stub is transit only); money and tenancy have no code path in this diff — no surface can exercise them.

environment_fixes_during_preflight: web dev server restarted (was stopped for turbo build)
notes.android_login_constraint: uiautomator cannot dump the LOGIN screen (ambient gradient never idles — launcher and post-login screens dump fine). Login transit uses coordinate taps + screencap; every assertion happens post-login via dumps.
notes.android_prewarmed_state: app is logged in and sitting on Home when this run starts

instructions: navigate to http://localhost:3002/design/gallery

assert the three section headings exist: 'Pattern — useZodForm (contract schema drives validation)', 'Pattern — usePaginatedList (load more) + usePagedList (pager)', 'Pattern — ApiErrorText (copy from @heliogrid/i18n, never hand-written)'
in the form section fill Name='Asha Patil' and Phone='+919876543210', click Save
read the ApiErrorText section texts
steps.expected: a 'submitted: Asha Patil · +919876543210' line appears; error section shows 'You don't have access to do that.' (FORBIDDEN), 'Something went wrong on our side. Try again. · Ref: req_demo2' (INTERNAL), and 'Lead already won.' (route-specific fallback)

instructions: in the pagination section click 'Load more' until it disappears, recording the counter label after each settle
in the pager click Next to page 2 then page 3, attempt Next at page 3, Prev back to 1, attempt Prev at 1
after each pager action record the label and the visible row count (must never be 0 mid-flip — keepPreviousData)
resize viewport to 375x812 and assert the form + pagination sections render without horizontal scroll
steps.expected: counter walks 5/12 → 10/12 → 12/12 then the Load more button is gone; pager reaches 'page 3 of 3' with Next disabled, returns to 'page 1 of 3' with Prev disabled; row count never 0 between flips; 375px renders without horizontal overflow

instructions: reload /design/gallery
click Save with both fields empty; record field errors
type '98765' into Phone, blur the field; record the phone field error
click 'Simulate server VALIDATION_FAILED'; record where the message renders
steps.expected: empty submit shows 'Name is required'; invalid phone shows 'must be E.164, e.g. +919876543210' after blur; the simulate button lands 'phone already exists on another lead' ON the phone field (below the input, not a toast or page-level banner)

instructions: reload /design/gallery; fill valid Name+Phone; double-click Save as fast as possible
record how many 'submitted:' lines exist

steps.expected: exactly one 'submitted:' line; counter caps at 12/12 with exactly 12 rows and zero duplicate labels (dedupe by id); pager never exceeds 'page 3 of 3' and the list never renders empty
